text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: On the way back from going out with Neo Universe—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, I got the candy toy prize...! 
This penny candy shop is truly a hidden gem!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: What's inside is... the "Grimoire of Greed"?! It's recreated so well...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu, I never imagined you'd know the original novel for this too, Digital-san.
I'm so happy!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: H-Heeek, I-I'm so flattered...! It all started because the Umamusume idol I stan was in the live-action cast...!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
――?
“ASEM”... What is that...?
choice_data_list: It's like a string-pull lottery at a candy shop.
It's just like a string-pull lottery at a candy shop, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: "Detecting" 'fun' in Agnes Digital and Zenno Rob Roy... How interesting.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Hello, Uni-san!
Could it be that you're here to draw from
the thousand-string raffle too?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
No...
Neo Universe's "trajectory" is the way home.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
However... as for the "Senbon Kuji,"
I wish to perform the action of "drawing."

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: I see...! We've both drawn once, so please, you go next!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaa... to think I'd be here to witness Universe-san's thousand-string lottery challenge...!
Praise be, praise beee...!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: ――What is this?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: I-Is this... the "Holy Dragon Sword" candy toy...!?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: A-A super rare item, LET'S GOOOOO! Universe-san, your luck is straight-up god-tier!!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
The "readings" for both of them are spiking rapidly...
They really are feeling "fun"...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Still, what is the "factor"...?
There is insufficient information for "analysis"...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I still don't quite understand why Agnes Digital and the others look like they're having so much fun.
Though, if I interact with the two of them more, perhaps...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
...? Neo-san, is something the matter?
Is something bothering you...?
choice_data_list: Um... do you have any other sweet recommendations?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
A recommendation? Let me see...
This popping cotton candy was quite popular at one point, wasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Oh, how nostalgic...! I remember collecting tons of those Umamusume bonus photo cards...!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
...? "Collecting" photos...?
Intent: unknown...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Ah, the cotton candy is delicious too, of course!
It crackles and pops inside your mouth...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Oh, what nostalgia...! Those days spent buying up everything in sight just for the photo cards...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Playing Carrot Rock-Paper-Scissors on the way home with the spoils on the line was a total classic, too...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Carrot Rock-Paper-Scissors!
How nostalgic, I used to play that all the time too!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
――? Both of their "values" are rising again...
"Analysis" of the "cheap candy" is complete, but...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
The "magnitude" is in the negatives... "Detecting"
the brightness of an 'Unknown'... What on earth is that...?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
If we can "observe" that...
Could we, someday, "connect"...?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
The "code" is... 『Nostalgic』 『Classic』
『Carrot Rock-Paper-Scissors』...—

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
......
......"Analysis" impossible.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: You two are... truly "dazzling", aren't you...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Uni-san...?
Is something the matter? You seem a bit down...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Ah...! I'm so sorry, my nostalgic ramblings
must have been so boring to listen to!
Forgive my rudeness...!!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"ASEM"... The specific problem is "void."
It means "don't worry about it."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Though she says that... deep down, she probably wants to have fun together. But she doesn't understand what 'fun' is. In that case—
choice_data_list: I have cheap candy I like too.
I have a favorite dagashi snack, too.
Have you ever heard of prank sweets?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Though she says that... deep down, she probably wants to have fun together. But she doesn't understand what 'fun' is. In that case—
choice_data_list: I have cheap candy I like too.
I have a favorite dagashi snack, too.
Have you ever heard of prank sweets?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I buy a piece of nostalgic cheap candy
and share it with everyone.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
――"LAMD."
This is... "Delicious."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Yes, it has such a simple, nostalgic
flavor...!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
—Sfera.
This is... "sharing" "deliciousness," right...?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Hngh...! What an adorable smile...!
W-Wait, are you sure it's okay for me to be
your "first contact"? Is this just a convenient dream??

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It was just a single cheap sweet, but sharing that delicious moment together was special. Clutching that precious memory tightly, I headed on my way home.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I offer Neo Universe some gum.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
“—This is... 'the unknown.'
Should I 'extract' it?”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Pweeeeep!)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Hyaaah!?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
—I-I was startled...
That's "Shocking Gum," isn't it?
It's been so long since I last saw one...!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
————"Big Bang."
Neo Universe 'surprised' too.
choice_data_list: Yeah. Just like Zenno Rob Roy.
Yeah. Just like Zenno Rob Roy.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
—!
A "shared"... sphira, right?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After muttering softly,
Neo Universe's cheeks relaxed ever so slightly.
